capabilities: Display vault tasks as cards on kanban boards
Organize columns by dates or tags
Complete, delete, and re-date tasks from the board
Filter tasks per board by file, path, or tag
Customize card colors and styling with CSS snippets
disambiguation: Tasks are not moved into the plugin; they stay in their original markdown files and the board edits them in place.
extras: README warns the plugin parses all markdown files at startup with no cache, so it may perform poorly on large vaults or files; recurring tasks are not supported from the board; settings are stored in .obsidian and older versions are backed up automatically.
problem: Obsidian tasks are scattered across notes with no visual board for tracking them by due date or status.

relations.evidence: Cardboard is compatible with the Due and Completion date formats used in both Tasks and Dataview.
